name: Claude Code v2.1.217 — Subagent Concurrency Cap; Nested Subagents Off by Default; Emoji Shortcuts
hook: v2.1.217 (July 21) adds two new subagent safety rails: a max concurrent subagents cap (default 20, tune via `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS`) and nested subagents disabled by default (opt in with `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH`). Also ships emoji shortcode autocomplete (`:heart:` → ❤️) and fixes a critical startup bug where SKILL.md paths with many brace groups were OOM-killing or stalling the CLI, plus Windows auto-update failures that left claude.exe missing.

name: Bun Rewritten in Rust by 64 Claude Instances in 11 Days — Claude Code Now 10% Faster on Linux
hook: Bun's founder Jarred Sumner ported 960K+ lines of Zig to Rust in 11 days using 64 parallel Claude instances running pre-release Fable 5 (~$165K API spend), motivated by a Zig memory leak that was hitting Claude Code — Bun's largest customer. A documented example of Anthropic dogfooding Claude Code at scale for a production-critical migration.

name: ralph-wiggum — Official Anthropic Plugin; Self-Drive Mode That Keeps Claude Looping Until Done
hook: Official Anthropic plugin that puts Claude Code into self-drive: you write one prompt and a completion condition, then walk away — the plugin intercepts each session exit and re-feeds the original task, letting Claude iterate and fix mistakes until it finishes or hits max iterations. Named after The Simpsons' relentlessly optimistic Ralph Wiggum. Key warning from the docs: without an explicit iteration cap, Claude will happily exhaust all available tokens; always set a limit before stepping away.

name: Levent Alpoge Used Claude Fable 5 to Disprove the 87-Year-Old Jacobian Conjecture
hook: On July 20, mathematician Levent Alpoge (Harvard / Anthropic) posted an explicit polynomial map C³→C³ with Jacobian determinant −2 that is not invertible — a counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture (Keller, 1939), one of algebraic geometry's central open problems for 87 years. Alpoge credited Claude Fable 5 for the key construction. A verification preprint was filed the same day; independently checked but not yet journal-published. The highest-profile scientific result attributed directly to a Claude model.
